description: Context profiles for Grand Architect. Each profile defines a minimal set of files to load for a class of task. The goal is to reduce context, not multiply it. Never load the entire Bible or all architecture docs into a single agent startup context.

core.description: Minimum context for any task in this repository.
core.rationale: Universal rules plus the verified front door. Every agent needs this and nothing more for trivial tasks.

ui.description: Tasks touching the editor UI: panels, viewport, toolbar, command palette.
ui.rationale: UI work needs the action registry and store, not the cosmology or the constraint solver.

engine.description: Tasks touching the engine kernel, plugin SDK, or architect control plane.
engine.rationale: Engine work needs the kernel and architect types. Simulation plugins are loaded on demand per task.

authorial.description: Tasks touching the xianxia design corpus, content schemas, or vertical slice authoring.
authorial.rationale: Retrieve specific Bible sections on demand by querying the corpus-extension index. Never load all 48 docs automatically.
authorial.retrievalHint: Use Grep or Glob to find docs by heading. Each doc filename starts with NN_ (zero-indexed). The corpus is FROZEN.

physics.description: Tasks touching Rapier physics, character controller, collision, embodiment.
physics.rationale: Physics work needs PhysicsRuntime, BVH, and the Rapier WASM module. Bible is irrelevant.

terrain.description: Tasks touching terrain generation, voxel terrain studio, streaming, destruction.
terrain.rationale: Terrain work needs the voxel studio, frontier terrain, production factory, and the terrain-worker mini-service.

taskSpecificProfiles.description: Built on demand from a handoff's TASK.md. The handoff's `relevantProfiles` field selects zero or more base profiles to extend with the handoff's own files.

defaults.onMultipleProfiles: Union the includes; respect excludes from each profile; cap at the smallest maxApproxTokens.
